summary: Russian forces conducted coordinated missile and drone attacks across multiple Ukrainian regions, with a specific threat of 4-8 missile launches targeting Odesa port infrastructure within 20-30 minutes. Ukrainian air defenses reported shooting down 126 enemy targets including cruise missiles and Shahed drones during overnight attacks. Multiple Russian aircraft including Su-30, Su-34, and Su-57/35 were detected over Black Sea and Azov Sea regions.
key_points: Russian forces threatened to launch 4-8 missiles of different types against Odesa region within 20-30 minutes, targeting major port facilities in Chornomorsk, Odesa, and Pivdenne cities (Source: @mon1tor_ua/68895).
Ukrainian air defenses shot down 126 enemy targets including 3 X-59/69 cruise missiles and 123 Shahed drones during overnight attacks from Crimea and Russian territory (Source: @kpszsu/68283).
Russian tactical aviation conducted multiple launches of guided aerial bombs against Zaporizhzhia region with increased activity on southern front (Source: @kpszsu/68266, @kpszsu/68315).
Reactive Shahed drones launched from Dnipropetrovsk region toward Kirovohrad region, specifically targeting Oleksandrivka area (Source: @mon1tor_ua/68913).
Shahed drone attacks reported on Cherkasy region and multiple locations across Dnipropetrovsk region including Synelnykove and Bozhedarivka (Source: @mon1tor_ua/68911, @kpszsu/68330).
Russian aircraft detected over Black Sea including Su-30 and Orlan UAV, while Su-34 and Su-57/35 aircraft monitored over Azov Sea region (Source: @mon1tor_ua/68895).

Ukraine and nine European nations formed Anti-Ballistic Missile Coalition to pool defense technologies and create unified missile defense capability (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31593, @DeepStateUA/23638).

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces maintain high-intensity air campaign with coordinated missile and drone strikes across multiple Ukrainian regions. The specific threat against Odesa port infrastructure indicates potential targeting of critical maritime logistics capabilities. Multiple aircraft types operating over Black Sea and Azov Sea suggest sustained aviation pressure. Reactive Shahed drone deployments from occupied territories demonstrate expanded launch capabilities. Potential mass strike against Kyiv infrastructure represents elevated risk to capital region.
sections.regional_response: Ukraine and nine European nations formed Anti-Ballistic Missile Coalition to enhance collective defense capabilities. The coalition includes France, Germany, UK, Italy, Spain, Netherlands, Norway, Sweden, and Denmark pooling defense technologies. Poland called on young Ukrainian refugees to return and join armed forces. Hungary and Czech Republic maintained positions against providing military aid to Ukraine. Slovak President confirmed continued non-support stance for Ukrainian military assistance.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian tactical aviation demonstrated increased operational tempo with multiple Su-34 launch maneuvers and guided aerial bomb deployments. Air defense systems successfully intercepted majority of incoming threats but some impacts reported at five locations. Drone launch patterns show expanded use of reactive Shahed systems from occupied territories. Coalition formation suggests Western allies seeking enhanced integrated air defense architecture. Continued targeting of port infrastructure indicates focus on maritime logistics disruption.
